Chemical and Physical Characteristics
and physical characteristics of the type of soils which occur in the Project area. The SCS has conducted numerous analyses on soil profiles during the course of their work in southeastern Montana. In addition, Westmoreland Resources has sampled numerous soil profiles within Tract III in compliance with the Montana Strip Mining and Reclamation Act Specifically, 38 soil profiles have been sampled in which soil was collected from the genetic horizons of representative soil phases which would be affected by the mining operation. In addition, three samples have been obtained of re-topsoiled disturbed areas around the railroad-loop and sediment pond (Sample Nos. 74-13, -14, and -15). Also, three soil profiles were sampled at the site of the Mine Administration Building, located in the SW 1/4 NE 1/4 Sec. 21, TlN, R37E (Sample Nos. 74-18, -19, and -20).
